remarks: Special and Spacious with Water Views in the Heart of New Canaan! Overlooking the majestic Mead Park pond, this updated 4 bedroom/4 full bathroom townhouse offers a unique opportunity for in-town living with serene views as far as the eye can see! The Living Room and Primary Bedroom balconies overlook unobstructed scenic vistas, while a short walk from the private, ground-level patio offers you Park View's own gate to access everything the park has to offer! Abundant, grassy common areas for dog walking, picnicking and fun. Enjoy three large Bedrooms and two Full Bathrooms upstairs. The lower walk-out level has an over-sized Family Room, Office/Fourth Bedroom, Full Bath, Laundry and Storage. The inviting main floor is perfect for entertaining with Living Room, Den/Dining Room, Eat-in Kitchen and another Full Bathroom. Don't miss this very rare opportunity to enjoy every season of Mead Park's natural beauty only a few steps from the charming village of New Canaan.
